stops.question: "Only serve Claude subscription users" — does that mean just changing how it's shipped, or also cutting the API-key-billed autonomous runner?
options: Distribution only — Stop publishing to npm; the plugin becomes the sole install path. Keep the CLI, `loop`, `schedule`, and the API-key runner in the repo.

Distribution + drop the API runner — Also delete src/runner (Anthropic SDK driver), `loop`, `schedule`, eval, and the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY paths. The MCP server + skill + commands become the entire product. Biggest simplification, irreversible-ish.
Distribution + shrink the CLI — Drop npm and keep the runner code, but reduce the CLI to what the plugin actually invokes and move the rest behind a dev-only entry point.

stops.question: Should OST-Agent do its own web discovery, or delegate it to the host agent?

Keyless general web — DuckDuckGo or SearXNG — Real general-web results, no key, but it is scraping or volunteer infrastructure.

stops.question: What should the build loop do when the tree's own gate refuses a candidate? How far should the build loop carry a change on its own? How often should the build loop fire?
options: Build the loop's own blockers only (Recommended) — Restrict it to internal tooling rows the discovery passes keep naming as blocking themselves.
Build top-ranked anyway, flag the debt — Ignore the gate; each pass builds the highest-ranked solution and the report names every untested assumption.
Respect the gate strictly — Build only solutions with a recorded assumption-test result; today that is zero.
Open a PR and stop (Recommended) — Branch, commit, push, open PR with gates green — then wait for you.
Merge to main when CI is green — Full ship-it flow, unattended.
Every 6 hours (Recommended) — Four a day leaves room under a spend ceiling.
Every 2 hours — More throughput; PRs may stack up faster than you review them.
Hourly, matching discovery — Same cadence as the discovery loop, offset so they don't collide.
stops.answer: Respect the gate strictly / Merge to main when CI is green / Hourly (entry 130)
